notes: Holopup's world line (docs/SKYFALL_PLAN.md): a Holopup attuned to a world's Signal Shard (party menu) evolves into that world's form; it becomes the final form at level 45. Holofox stays its normal evolution. Built by tools/build.js after the World-Echo forms, always in this order (save files store species by position).

line.lore2: A swarm of glowing sand-bugs drifts around it like a dust storm it carries everywhere.
line.lore3: A regal desert jackal in scarab armour. Its swarm forms a sun disc behind its head.

line.lore2: Gears and riveted plates cover it now. It sniffs out scrap the way other pups sniff out treats.
line.lore3: A war-wolf of salvaged machinery with a furnace glowing in its chest.

line.lore2: Slime drips from its mushroom-cap ears. Swamp spores ride the air wherever it shakes itself.
line.lore3: A lanky swamp wolf with a toxic mushroom forest growing on its back.

line.lore2: Its light flows like water. Bubbles rise from it even on dry land.
line.lore3: A sea-wolf whose mane is a rushing wave that loops into a whirlpool.

line.lore2: Outlined like a neon sign, it crackles with static and hums when it is happy.
line.lore3: A sleek cyber-wolf traced with neon circuits, with a holographic tail.

line.lore2: Old runes glow across its fur, and two rune rings circle it like a slow dance.
line.lore3: A calm rune guardian, with stone tablets floating at its side.

line.lore2: Molten cracks glow through its obsidian body. Embers rise when it wags its tail.
line.lore3: A huge volcano-wolf with a mane of rolling flame and lava dripping from its jaw.

line.lore2: Its crystal fur is cold to the touch, and snowflakes fall wherever it naps.
line.lore3: A towering arctic wolf armoured in glacier ice, an aurora flowing from its mane.

line.lore2: A glowing double spiral runs down its back. Small leaves sprout where it walks.
line.lore3: A graceful stag-wolf with vine antlers twisting in a living spiral.

line.lore2: Its ears ring like bells, and sound ripples out from its chest when it barks.
line.lore3: A winged sky-hound whose wings are made of sound waves.

line.lore2: A void swirls in its chest. Only its star-point eyes show in the dark.
line.lore3: A looming eclipse-wolf crowned by a black sun ringed with silver light.

line.lore2: It streams plasma like a comet, too excited to ever stand still.
line.lore3: A radiant comet-wolf with a bright star burning in its chest.

line.lore2: Light splits into rainbows through its crystal body.
line.lore3: A towering crystal guardian with prism spires rising from its spine.

line.lore2: Small rocks orbit it, and it walks a hair above the ground.
line.lore3: An ancient guardian carrying a floating piece of the lost world Ystra.
